description: SORA CARS pixel-art race palette: cutscene-derived, hue-shifted ramps plus livery ramps. Generated; do not edit by hand.
method: Cell-interior samples (3x3 max channel diff <= 22, stride 2) of every input
weighted OKLab k-means (weight sqrt(count) * (1 + chroma / 0.1), a/b x1.15, k-means++ seed 12345), K=74, centroids snapped to the nearest observed colour

anchors: the renderer's fixed entries verbatim (CAR_COLOURS.plateRamp, CAR_COLOURS.lampRed, OIL_COLOURS, LAMP_HEAD_CORE); its measured colours (CAR_COLOURS, LINEWORK_COLOURS, FOLIAGE_GLINTS, SPARKLE_COLOURS, C >= 0.03) and the style spec's named cutscene colours within 0.015; a missing one replaces the nearest core entry within 0.03, else it is added

hue-shifted livery ramps for every race livery and club skin (two dark same-hue steps below L 0.36, dark end leaning toward indigo/violet, light end toward amber/cream; teal follows the cutscene teal car: sage-teal mid band, amber highlight), reusing close entries
greedy max-distance gap fill to 128 from cutscene material ramps, lamp/sun glow rings, accent regions and the 8-band sky strata of 7 cutscene skies

parameters.liveryShiftTaper: shift x min(1, step / 2): the darkest step never moves

quantizationErrorOKLab.note: nearest palette entry, plain OKLab distance, every pixel at stride 9 over all inputs
